    Minimal representation-infinite quotients #

    The second step of Lemma 3.1: a representation-infinite finite-dimensional algebra has a minimal representation-infinite quotient (one of least dimension), and quotients of split basic algebras are split basic.

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.IsMinimalRepInfinite (B : Type u) [Ring B] :
    Prop

    A ring is minimal representation-infinite if it is representation-infinite and all its proper quotients are representation-finite.
